text: This staff report is about a matter for which Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install an accessible loading zone on the south side of Victoria Avenue West, between the west limit of Victoria Avenue West and a point 15 metres further east. The loading zone will operate at all times to provide curb side access for Wheel-Trans vehicles.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the maximum one-hour parking regulation in effect from 9:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., on the south side of Victoria Avenue West, between the west end of Victoria Avenue West and a point 15 metres east. 2. Designated an accessible loading zone to operate at all times on the south side of Victoria Avenue West, between the west end of Victoria Avenue West and a point 15 metres east.
